[red[]]This is a mod that is a remake or enhancing serpulo for fun with additions to various turrets and units, sometimes with a rebalance.

[white[]]A mod that enhances serpulo by adding more ammunitions to turrets as well as enhancing the units. This is not intended to be for an actual rebalance mod.
